newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nordic Aluminium sets FIM 50/shr price in offering.
newsitem.headline: Nordic Aluminium sets FIM 50/shr price in offering.

text.p: Finnish aluminium profiles and components maker Nordic Aluminium said in a statement on Friday its offering of three million shares had been oversubscribed by over five times and set the offer price at 50 markka per share.
"Total demand was 5.4 times supply," it said adding that 96 percent of demand came from institutional investors.
Trading on the Helsinki Stock Exchange was expected to start on April 24, it said.
Institutions -- of which 58 percent were international and 42 percent Finnish -- bought 2.7 million shares and the public bought 300,000 shares, the company said.
Staff bought 24,080 new shares and board members bought 11,000 new shares at 45 markka each, with 25 percent of the personnel joining the offering.
Lead manager Enskilda has an over-allotment option for 450,000 shares, it said.

As a result of the offering, the ownership stake of funds managed by Morgan Stanley Capital Partners III had fallen to 21.3 percent from 68.0 percent, and the stake of funds managed by CapMan Capital Management Oy had fallen to 8.7 percent from 27.7 percent, it said. Management's stakes did not change.
